diagrams.name: dependency_installation_update
diagrams.title: Dependency Installation and Update
diagrams.description: Core workflow: Developer installs, updates, or removes packages via install/update/require commands, driving the full resolver-to-installer pipeline.

diagrams.name: project_initialization
diagrams.title: Project Initialization
diagrams.description: Developer initialises a new project (composer init / create-project), generating composer.json and bootstrapping the Composer instance.

diagrams.name: package_discovery_and_info
diagrams.title: Package Discovery and Information
diagrams.description: Developer searches, shows, and browses packages from remote repositories using the show/search commands and repository browsing.

diagrams.name: configuration_management
diagrams.title: Configuration Management
diagrams.description: Developer reads and writes Composer configuration (global and per-project) via the config command and JSON config source.
diagrams.scope: Config command and config source layer

diagrams.name: repository_management
diagrams.title: Repository Management
diagrams.description: Developer adds, removes, and configures package repositories; RepositoryManager creates and registers repository instances.

diagrams.name: vcs_source_integration
diagrams.title: VCS Source Integration
diagrams.description: Developer or system downloads packages from VCS sources (Git, GitLab, Perforce); VcsDriver/VcsDownloader fetch metadata and source.

diagrams.name: plugin_management
diagrams.title: Plugin Management
diagrams.description: Plugin Author creates and publishes plugins; Developer enables plugins; PluginManager validates, loads, and activates them.

diagrams.name: script_and_event_handling
diagrams.title: Script and Event Handling
diagrams.description: Developer triggers lifecycle scripts (post-install, pre-update, run-script); EventDispatcher fires Events consumed by plugins and scripts.

diagrams.name: security_audit
diagrams.title: Security Audit
diagrams.description: Developer runs composer audit; AuditConfig and advisory policies check installed packages for known vulnerabilities.

diagrams.name: package_download_and_filesystem
diagrams.title: Package Download and Filesystem Operations
diagrams.description: System downloads package archives (zip/tar), extracts them, and performs filesystem operations; FileDownloader and Filesystem utilities coordinate.
